# --seq: the units of 1 of 195 sequences; N2 and N3 hold their nodes to their own rows, so a 0 here is not a 0 for the file: verify7.py holds N2 across tiles and sequences, and the ref rows' passes to the whole file

column3: U1 units in file order: header; sequences in byte order; per sequence its tile and departures units by start, a tile before the blocks starting there, smaller blocks first; then detail units in order of their tile's start and then their number, a tile's blocks unit directly after its last detail unit; then its table
U2 a tile's name is its start, a multiple of tile written in decimal with no leading zero, and every ref step's offset lies in [name, name + tile)
U3 a tile's extent runs from the first base its ref rows' stretches cover to the last
U4 a tile or detail unit whose rows cover no base, at p, takes [p, p+1), [p-1, p) where p is |S|, or [0, 0) where |S| is 0; every other unit has an extent of at least 1 bp
U5 a tile lists ref rows, then at most one nodes row, then route rows, then walk rows, then abridged rows; a detail unit holds at most one nodes row, route rows and walk rows
U6 within a departure block lines are in order of start, end, then text
U7 every departure line overlaps each block it is in, or, a point, lies at the block's start
U8 a table's #unit line runs from 0 to |S|, where its sequence's last ref row ends, and is named .

U9 a unit holds only lines of its own kinds: tiles ref/nodes/route/walk/abridged, departure blocks departure, detail units nodes/route/walk, blocks units blocks; a unit of another kind is skipped with its rows
U10 every sequence in the file has at least one tile, so no table is empty
H1 #haplotype lists what each path with walk or abridged rows is listed under, sample#haplotype of three fields or more and the sample of fewer, once each in byte order, and no other
H2 revisited:i:0 means no ref row or departure record has a pass count above 1 and no walk row has @k or :k
H3 one #reference line names the reference sample, the sample of every ref row's path
H4 the reference is whole haplotypes: no path with walk or abridged rows, and no #haplotype line, is what a reference sequence is listed under or begins with that and #
R1 a ref row's lengths and passes have one entry per step, passes . exactly when every count is 1
R3 a tile of S holds at least one ref row, and ref rows of S only
R2 a tile's ref rows are written in hapOffset order
R4 no two ref rows of a sequence cover a base twice, so the offsets of R ascend
R5 every length a ref or nodes row states is at least 1
G1 a tile's walk rows are in order of path name in bytes, then fragStart, hapOffset and piece
G4 every node id is below 2^31

G6 a row has its kind's fixed columns, and any column after them is a tag NAME:T:value, its name letters and digits from a letter, its type one letter; the #walks line holds tags alone; a #unit line has its six columns and an #entry line its eight, with no tag
G5 #hole lines are the stretches of each sequence before |S| that no ref row's stretch covers, in order of sequence name in bytes, then start
N1 a nodes row lists the nodes the tile's route interiors visit, ids strictly ascending, and no other
N2 no route interior holds a node the reference passes once (ADR 0009, nearest-pass placement)
N3 a node has one length in every ref and nodes row of the file that holds it
N5 no route interior of a tile or of its detail units holds a node of the tile's own R
S1 SQ:Z: is on every ref and nodes row of a file or on none, and holds as many bases as the row's lengths add up to
T1 a route is stored the way round that sorts first: by entry (none first), then interior, handle by handle as integers and the shorter first where one begins the other, then exit (none first)
T2 each distinct route is written once per tile or detail unit, a route and its flip counting as one
T3 a route with no entry or no exit has a non-empty interior
T4 a route's entry and exit lie on R
T5 every route row of a tile or detail unit is taken by one of its walk rows
T6 route rows are in order of the first position in R of their entry's or exit's node, whichever is first, then by entry (none first), interior and exit
W1 every walk row decodes by the spec's rules to nsteps steps
W2 a walk row has one encoding: @k and :k only where they differ from the defaults, and flip 0 on a route that is its own flip
W3 a walk continues along R where R's next position is the step's, and takes a route with an empty interior only where it is not
W4 a walk row's start end is the span of all its placed steps
B1 where the #walks line states an abridgebytes above 0, a tile that keeps a walk row has rows, other than its abridged rows and from kind on, of at most that many bytes uncompressed

B2 where the #walks line states an abridge above 0, a tile that keeps a walk row has pieces costing at most that many interior steps: each piece's routes' interior steps once per use, plus a quarter of all its steps

B3 a tile moves the fewest W lines it can, costliest first: every moved line costs at least as much as every kept one, and, where the #walks line states both budgets and one of them above 0, with its last-numbered detail record put back the tile would cost more than abridge or its rows would be more than abridgebytes bytes
W5 each (path, fragStart, piece) has one walk or abridged row in the file, pieces numbered from 0 with none missing along one W line
A1 an abridged row's start end is its blocks row's start end
A2 every abridged row names a detail unit cs:d of its tile that exists, and every detail unit is named by one
A3 a W line's moved pieces in one tile share one detail record
A4 a detail unit holds the moved pieces of one W line
A5 a tile's detail numbers run from 0 with none missing
A6 a tile or detail unit holds a nodes row exactly when its routes have an interior step, and at most one
A7 a tile's detail records are numbered from 0 in order of cost, the costliest W line first
A8 an abridged row states its piece's walk row in its detail unit: the same start end, path, fragStart, hapOffset, piece and nsteps
A9 an abridged row has eleven columns: seq start end abridged path fragStart hapOffset piece nsteps hapBp detail
A10 an abridged row's hapBp is at least 1 and is what its blocks row's items add up to
A11 an abridged row's hapBp is the bp of the steps its piece's walk row in its detail unit decodes to
A12 an abridged piece 0 starts at fragStart, and an abridged piece's hapOffset plus hapBp is the hapOffset of its W line's next piece, in that piece's walk or abridged row

A13 the bp of an abridged piece's stretch of its contig, hapOffset over hapBp, within a record's of its sequence and path, hapStart over ownBp, is its blocks list's trailing run where hapStart is where its last block ends on the contig, its leading run where hapStart plus ownBp is where its first block begins there, and 0 otherwise; it is never the whole piece
K1 every tile with abridged rows has exactly one blocks unit, named by its start, and no other tile has one
K2 a blocks unit's rows are its tile's abridged rows one for one, in their order, by path, fragStart and piece
K3 a blocks row's items add up to the bp of the steps its piece's walk row in its detail unit decodes to
K4 a blocks row's start end is the hull of its blocks, and a blocks unit's the hull of its rows
K6 a block is maximal: none begins where the block right before it ended, running the same way
K7 a block item is <d><+|-><len>: d a decimal that may be 0 or negative, with no leading zero and no -0, len a decimal of at least 1 with no leading zero

K8 a blocks row has eight columns, and its list's items are each a block or, all digits, a run off R of at least 1 bp with no leading zero; no two runs stand side by side, and there is at least one block

K9 a W line's pieces tile its contig: a piece ends where the line's next piece starts, a walk row's piece running from hapOffset over its steps' bp and an abridged one from hapOffset over every item of its blocks row's list
K10 a W line's piece 0 starts at fragStart, its walk or abridged row's hapOffset

K11 a departure record of an abridged piece's sequence and path whose hapStart is where the piece's last block ends on its contig, hapOffset plus its list's items up to there, has an ownBp of at least the list's trailing run
K12 a blocks row's list starts with a run off R only on a W line's piece 0
K13 no piece ends above 2^53 on its contig: a walk row's hapOffset plus its steps' bp, an abridged row's hapOffset plus hapBp
D1 a departure record's ownTiles are tile names of its sequence that exist, in no repeat
D2 a record has at most two ownTiles
D3 a departure record's extent holds both breakpoints and is at least the breakpoint stretch
D4 the ref rows of S hold a node ending at a + leave's or - rejoin's breakpoint and one starting at the other kind's
D5 a departure line's ownBp >= missingBp; strands are + or -; passes >= 1
O1 ownTiles are the tiles of S holding the record's own steps, the steps strictly between its leave step and its rejoin step, in the path's order
O2 an own step not placed on the reference takes the tile of the last step placed on the reference before it in its W line, or, leading its W line, of the first after it
O4 the own steps in the file lie in the tiles ownTiles names or in another sequence's tiles, and their bp plus missingBp is at most ownBp
L1 a record's leave step is the last step on R of its piece, and its rejoin step the first on R of its piece
O5 a record's own steps in an abridged piece of its sequence are the piece's steps within hapStart over ownBp cut to hapOffset over hapBp, and no other
D6 a departure line's start end runs from the first base of its end nodes to the last, widened to the breakpoint stretch where that is wider
